title: Villeroy; Henri IV to Pierre Jeannin and fellow envoys, 1607 (Français 3516 — Villeroy / royal cipher)

steps.what: George Lasry (with ChatGPT Astra 6 and Anthropic Opus 5.5) transcribed and deciphered the item: 2/15 pages transcribed; 2 more in part; 2/15 pages deciphered; 2 more in part; Transcribed passages: 1,145 elements, 1,099 identified. Report section: see report.

Spot-check against the Gallica image (https://openapi.bnf.fr/iiif/image/v3/ark:/12148/btv1b9059630p/f148/full/1600,/0/default.jpg): f86r cipher lines 8-11: contemporary interlinear reads "comme a tous ceux qui affectionnent ceste union sans toutesfois par trop vous fonder ou confier aux belles parolles de son agent ny des autres qui penchent de son coste car ilz sont tous trompeurs Mais si nous" = his excerpt; no own sign-by-sign decode (key table not checked) Verdict: confirmed.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): only George Lasry's report excerpt (lasry_entry.md) is in the repository; his full transcription and decryption are not, so they are recorded as missing (needs contributor: George Lasry). A contemporary interlinear decipherment is on ff. 86 and 112 (image only); the letters are probably printed in Jeannin, Négociations (1656; 1875).
